about: A three-page LaTeX article whose charts are drawn by pgfplots (vector graphics with real text labels), with setup numbers that must be skipped, 'Figs. 1 and 2' citations, a repeated sentence, claims in captions and a mix of true and false statements.

claims.sentence: All models were trained for 20 epochs on 4 GPUs with a batch size of 256.
The learning rate was reduced by 10% every 5 epochs.
claims.why: setup with 'reduced by 10%': not a chart claim

claims.sentence: ResNet-50 achieved 91.2% validation accuracy at epoch 20.
ViT-S reached 90.0% validation accuracy at epoch 20.
At epoch 10, ViT-S is 4.3 points lower than ResNet-50.
From epoch 2 to epoch 20, the training loss of ViT-S fell by 71%.
The training loss of ResNet-50 is 0.46 at epoch 20.
On SVHN, ViT-S achieves 93.8% test accuracy.
On CIFAR-10, ResNet-50 is 6.0 points better than ViT-S.
ViT-S does not reach the accuracy of ResNet-50 at any epoch, staying below 88%.

claims.why: a claim inside a caption (v3 A4)
